speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a newborn with increasing yellowing of your eyes and skin; have you noticed if the urine is dark or if the stools are pale or clay-colored?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-week-old female newborn. The patient has been experiencing increasing yellow discoloration of her eyes and skin for 2 days. She was born at 39 weeks' gestation, initially weighed 3066 g and now weighs 3200 g. The patient is exclusively breastfed.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Jaundice (Breastfeeding Jaundice). The history of a 2-week-old exclusively breastfed infant with increasing jaundice and normal stool/urine color (implied by the lack of reported dark urine/pale stools) is consistent with breastfeeding jaundice rather than biliary obstruction. Given the infant is 2 weeks old and still jaundiced, I recommend checking total and direct bilirubin levels to rule out other causes. REQUEST TEST: Bilirubin_total_direct.
